notes.title: Why are the user reviews so positive?
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694030/4298d6748fa96263f842ef4860a744245779725b.png"][/img][/p][p]Sales of “小枠内館の祝 KOWAKUNAI CELEBRATION” have exceeded 500 copies! [/p][p]Thank you very much to everyone who purchased and played the game. [/p][p][/p][p]This game places too much emphasis on being a “non-scary horror game,”  and was created with the intention of sacrificing its entertainment value as a game. [/p][p]So why are the user reviews so positive? [/p][p]If you're planning to write a review, please feel free to give it a low rating, [/p][p]as it shouldn't be ranked alongside other masterpieces.  [/p][p]Next time I make a game, I'll try to make it more fun to play.[/p][p][/p][p]Please play El Shaddai. [/p]
